relation_to_rt006_v1: RT006 V1 remains BLOCKED because no control universe had been frozen. V2 is a separately frozen post-hoc Red diagnostic and receives zero promotion credit.
control_universe_authority: Reuse the established six-asset Crypto Lab major-asset universe concept; exclude BTC (denominator) and BNB (target). Fixed controls: ETHBTC, SOLBTC, XRPBTC, DOGEBTC.
historical_event_set: Exactly the 66 already-open selected Launchpool events across pre-Discovery, Discovery and independent 2025 OOS. No event additions/deletions.
data_source: Binance Data Vision Spot monthly 15m archives; provider CHECKSUM mandatory. For BNBBTC target, downloaded monthly hash must also equal the canonical historical source-manifest hash where available.

alignment.entry: first 15m open strictly greater than the frozen Launchpool signal timestamp

outputs.basket: For each event with at least 3 of 4 controls complete, equal event weight; basket return = median control gross return. Report BNB minus control-basket gross differential.
outputs.differential_test: 10,000 event-level sign-flip permutations of BNB minus median-control differential, seed 20260927; report two-sided fraction abs(permutation mean) >= abs(observed mean).
outputs.availability_gate: At least 80% of the 66 events must have >=3 controls; otherwise BLOCKED.

interpretation: If broad alt/BTC controls show similar event-aligned strength and BNB-specific differential is weak, challenge the BNB-specific utility mechanism. If BNB materially exceeds controls, asset placebo does not falsify BNB specificity. Diagnostic only.
